servicesPage.heroDescription: A quantitative-science partner to clinical trials, public-health programmes, research institutions and data-driven organisations.
servicesPage.sectionHeading: A wide range of data science services
servicesPage.sectionSubheading: Offered individually or as an integrated package across the life of a study. Click any card to see full details.

surveyMethodology.title: Survey Methodology & Field Data Systems
surveyMethodology.desc: Designing surveys that produce defensible estimates, and the field systems that collect them cleanly the first time.
details: Sample design — stratification, PPS and multi-stage cluster sampling
GIS and spatial sampling: PSU delineation, gridded enumeration-area frames
Electronic data capture in SurveyCTO / ODK / XLSForm
Weighting, non-response adjustment and design-based variance estimation
Coverage, serosurvey, KAP, nutrition and health-facility assessments
surveyMethodology.outputs: Sampling plan, programmed instrument, field manuals, weighting report, public-use dataset.

statisticalConsultancy.title: Statistical Consultancy
statisticalConsultancy.desc: A senior statistician on call for design, analysis and the questions reviewers will eventually ask.
details: Study and experimental design: hypotheses, endpoints, estimands, randomization
Applied modelling — regression, mixed models, survival analysis, Bayesian approaches
Causal inference: propensity scores, matching, instrumental variables
Statistical analysis plans (SAPs) and reproducible analysis
Methods review and statistical input for manuscripts and theses
statisticalConsultancy.outputs: Study design memo, SAP, analysis report with reproducible code, reviewer-response support.

clinicalTrialSupport.title: Clinical Trial Support
clinicalTrialSupport.desc: End-to-end biostatistics and data services for interventional and observational studies, aligned to ICH-GCP.
details: Protocol and statistical-section development, endpoint and estimand definition
Sample-size, power and adaptive / interim-analysis planning
CRF design, edit checks, database build in REDCap and comparable EDC platforms
Analysis to CDISC-aligned standards, CONSORT-compliant reporting
Pharmacovigilance and safety-data handling, listings and summaries
clinicalTrialSupport.outputs: Protocol statistics, SAP, validated trial database, CSR-ready tables, listings and figures.

dsmbSupport.title: Data & Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB)
dsmbSupport.desc: Independent statistical membership and the unblinded analytics that keep trial participants safe.
details: Independent statistician membership on DSMBs and safety-monitoring committees
DSMB charters, stopping rules and group-sequential frameworks
Preparation of closed and open safety reports for board review
Unblinded interim analyses delivered independently of the study team
Benefit–risk summaries and minuted recommendations to sponsors
dsmbSupport.outputs: DSMB charter, interim safety reports, group-sequential plan, independent statistician sign-off.

medicalWriting.title: Medical & Scientific Writing
medicalWriting.desc: Turning analysis into clear, submission-ready scientific text — written to report what the data actually show.
details: Manuscripts, abstracts and conference posters, including methods and results sections
Clinical study reports, protocols and statistical sections
Systematic reviews, meta-analyses and evidence syntheses (PRISMA-aligned)
Policy briefs and technical reports for non-specialist audiences
Journal submission support, reviewer responses and revision handling
medicalWriting.outputs: Publication-ready manuscript, CSR, technical report, reviewer-response document.

grantsProposals.title: Grants & Proposal Development
grantsProposals.desc: Strengthening the quantitative spine of competitive applications — the part funders scrutinise hardest.
details: Study-design, sampling and statistical sections for grant applications
Power and sample-size justification, and analysis plans reviewers can assess
Monitoring-and-evaluation and data-management plans aligned to funder requirements
Budgeting and justification for data, analytics and statistical components
Concept notes, full proposals and responses to reviewer queries
grantsProposals.outputs: Methods and analysis sections, sample-size justification, M&E and data-management plans.

dataManagement.title: Data Management
dataManagement.desc: Clean, well-governed data with an audit trail — the foundation everything else depends on.
details: Database design and build, EDC configuration, and ETL / data-integration pipelines
Data-quality monitoring: validation rules, automated checks, query management
Data cleaning, harmonization and linkage, including record matching and de-duplication
Governance: data-management plans, SOPs, audit trails, de-identification
Secure storage, controlled access and analysis-ready dataset preparation
dataManagement.outputs: Data-management plan, validated database, DQ reports, locked analysis dataset, linkage SOP.

statisticalProgramming.title: Statistical Programming & Software
statisticalProgramming.desc: Production-quality code and tools — well documented, version-controlled and reproducible.
details: Statistical programming in R, Python, Stata and SAS, including package development
Reproducible analytical workflows, automated reporting (R Markdown / Quarto)
Interactive dashboards (Shiny, Power BI) for monitoring and dissemination
Methodological software — simulation engines and custom statistical methods
Code review, validation and refactoring of inherited analysis code
statisticalProgramming.outputs: Documented codebase, reproducible pipeline, dashboard, validated analysis package.

mathematicalModelling.title: Mathematical & Statistical Modelling
mathematicalModelling.desc: Models that explain mechanisms, project forward and quantify uncertainty honestly.
details: Infectious-disease and compartmental models (SIR / SEIR) and transmission dynamics
Forecasting and time-series methods for surveillance and programme planning
Bayesian hierarchical modelling, small-area estimation and spatial models
Simulation, scenario analysis and sensitivity / uncertainty quantification
Latent-variable and multi-omics integration methods
mathematicalModelling.outputs: Calibrated model, forecasts with uncertainty intervals, simulation study, technical documentation.

researchAnalytics.title: Research & Analytics
researchAnalytics.desc: Full-cycle research support and the applied data science behind data-driven decisions.
details: End-to-end study support — from research question through analysis to dissemination
Epidemiological and public-health analytics, including surveillance and programme evaluation
Predictive modelling and machine learning where genuinely warranted
Data visualization, KPI tracking and analytical reporting for operational decisions
Secondary analysis and evidence synthesis of existing data assets
researchAnalytics.outputs: Research outputs, evaluation reports, predictive models with validation, decision-ready analytics.

trainingCapacity.title: Training & Capacity Building
trainingCapacity.desc: Leaving teams able to do the work themselves — not dependent on us.
details: Hands-on courses in R, Python, Stata and reproducible research
Applied biostatistics, survey methods, epidemiology and data management
Mentored, on-the-job support for analysts, students and institutional staff
Curriculum design and tailored in-house workshops in English and French
Ongoing methods support and analytical mentoring after handover
trainingCapacity.outputs: Course materials, hands-on workshops, mentoring plan, certificate-ready curricula.

items.b01: The standard entry point to the tidyverse: importing, tidying, transforming, visualising and modelling data in R.
items.b02: Data wrangling with pandas and NumPy, by the creator of pandas.
items.b03: NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib and scikit-learn for the working data scientist.
items.b04: Statistical thinking for a general and professional audience — excellent for non-specialist stakeholders.
items.b05: A clear, modern treatment of survey sampling theory and practice.
items.b06: The foundational text on total survey error, questionnaire design and survey operations.
items.b07: The reference for design-based inference and calibration estimators in complex surveys.
items.b08: The most accessible route into modern statistical learning; Springer-authorised free PDFs.
items.b09: The advanced companion to ISL — the deeper theory behind the methods.
items.b10: Indispensable for applied regression, splines, validation and prediction modelling.
items.b11: The standard reference for logistic regression, contingency tables and models for categorical outcomes.
items.b12: The core text on trial design, conduct, monitoring and analysis.
items.b13: Practical guidance on research questions, study designs and sample size.
items.b14: Group-sequential methods and interim monitoring — directly relevant to DSMB statistical work.
items.b15: The definitive practical guide to running and contributing to DSMBs.
items.b16: A practical guide to writing and publishing in the biological and health sciences.
items.b17: A long-standing standard on structuring and submitting scientific manuscripts.
items.b18: The essential checklists every manuscript and protocol should follow.
items.b19: A structured, widely used workbook for building competitive proposals.
items.b20: On narrative and structure in both papers and funding proposals.
items.b21: How R really works — essential for writing robust, efficient R code and packages.
items.b22: The reference for building, testing and shipping R packages.
items.b23: Writing idiomatic, high-quality Python — a step beyond introductory texts.
items.b24: Principles of readable, maintainable code that apply across languages.
items.b25: A vendor-neutral map of the modern data lifecycle.
items.b26: The reference on the systems behind reliable, scalable data infrastructure.
items.b27: The short, foundational paper on structuring data for analysis — free.
items.b28: The best modern introduction to applied Bayesian modelling.
items.b29: The comprehensive Bayesian reference; the authors provide a free PDF.
items.b30: The standard, fully free text on time-series forecasting.
items.b31: The reference for compartmental and transmission-dynamic models.
items.b33: The leading modern text on causal inference from observational data.
items.b34: A clear, applied medical-statistics text widely used in public-health training.
items.b35: Reproducible reporting and automated documents in R.
items.b36: The classic on data visualisation and the ethics of showing data well.
items.b37: A practical, free guide to making clear, honest figures.
